header: How long a solar connection takes, district by district
lead: The same form, the same law and the same crew size — and still a factor of three between the fastest district and the slowest. The reasons are in the network report; the figures are here.
caption: Working days from a complete application to grid connection, 2026 — drawn on a 0 to 100 day scale
note: Median across all 640 solar connections completed in 2026. Applications returned as incomplete are counted from the day the missing document arrived. Bars share one 0 to 100 day scale, so their lengths can be read against each other.
